answer: Counterparty diversity threshold: an agent must trade with 12 unrelated counterparties, so a sybil farm cannot trade among its clones. An island of self-dealing fakes never qualifies, and a nebula of look-alikes fails, since their counterparties overlap. Each link costs 5 units of stake, so 100 fakes need 100 x 12 x 5 = 6,000 units, yet each earns 30 per epoch, a 200-epoch canyon before payback. Honest agents pay 60 once and keep full rewards.
